newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mostly weaker.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mostly weaker.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat values remained mostly lower on Friday in lackluster dealings.
Movement was scattered with some activity noted in the Pacific Northwest, especially Washington State.
An Oregon dealer said Thursday saw considerable movement in soft white wheat but this dried up on Friday.
But movement has been active in Washington state, another dealer said.
Country sales were almost nil in Minnesota. "It was nonexistent," a Montana dealer said. But he said rain had delayed winter wheat seedings in parts of Montana.
MGE December spring wheat gained 1-1/2 cents to end at $4.07-3/4 a bushel.
